title: Ghent, paving expenses in the 15th century - dataset
descriptions: This dataset contains information about the paving expenses made by Ghent's city government during the first half of the 15th century (1401-1455). Each line corresponds to one mention of paving location in the city account. Two columns correpond to the GIS identifer of the location. NB: during the 15th century, expenses are no longer registered per year but per month, which increases automatically the number of expenses since a paving site could be mentioned several time in the register if the work last more than one month.
